quests.instruction: Blend the sounds together. What word do they make: "/g/ /a/ /s/"?
quests.question: /g/ /a/ /s/
quests.hint: Put the sounds together one after another: g... a... s. Say them fast!
quests.explanation: You blended g + a + s to make the word "GAS"! Great blending!
quests.funFact: "GAS" ⛽ is made of just three sounds: g, a, and s.
